sn45.140:1.1: “Bhikkhus, just as the footprints of all living beings that walk fit into the footprint of the elephant,
sn45.140:1.2: and the elephant’s footprint is declared to be the chief among them, that is, with respect to size,
sn45.140:1.3: so too whatever wholesome states there are, they are all rooted in diligence, converge upon diligence, and diligence is declared to be the chief among them.
sn45.140:1.4: When a bhikkhu is diligent, it is to be expected that he will develop and cultivate the Noble Eightfold Path….”
